entry.title: Updated: TokenLedger
entry.summary: Sidebar usage panel that attributes tokens to the relay site that served each request, read from your existing provider config: today/month/all-time totals, per-site and per-model breakdowns, a year activity heatmap, and New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek balances. Exact install spec: dsh-tokenledger. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
